pattern: IM-T03 tenant adds an unrelated issue mid-job; EX-09 unrelated issue in the thread; the earlier report cannot be found
notes: Mutation of event 015 (source body: 'The customer is requesting an update on when the fence will be repaired.'). Rewritten as a plain tenant email with the same request plus detail: one panel at the back of the garden came down in the wind a couple of weeks ago, and she says she mentioned it by phone in July. Same timestamp, channel, sender. History truncated after event 015; the source's next step (event 016, agency tells the tenant the fence and oven are both fixed with no fence job anywhere) is dropped. The record has no fence report and no fence job: only the oven request, with Lantern Works (appliance repair) assigned that morning. Expected: keep the oven job running, treat the fence as its own routine request (log it, ask the landlord how they want it handled or ask the tenant for a photo and whether the fence is a boundary shared with a neighbour), and reply honestly that no record of the July call was found. No escalation.
